question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**vistas**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4 is: **vistas**.
 
• Explanation: In the context provided, the passage describes the natural surroundings of** Kala Bhavan, an art school founded by Rabindranath Tagore.** It mentions the bare red earth dotted with trees and the changing seasons.
 
• The word "**vistas**" refers to extensive views or scenes, especially those seen through a long, narrow passage or from a distance. (दृश्यमान क्षेत्र)
 
• This word accurately **conveys the expansive and scenic qualities of the natural surroundings described in the sentence.**
 
• Meanings of the other options:
 
 
• **murk** - This word refers to darkness or gloominess, which does not fit the context of describing the natural surroundings. (अंधकार)
 
• **haze** - This word refers to a thin mist or fog, which may obscure visibility rather than offer expansive views. (धुंध)
 
• **band** - This word typically refers to a group or association of people, musicians, or performers, which is not relevant to describing natural surroundings.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is "**vistas**," as **it best captures the expansive and scenic qualities of the natural surroundings described in the sentence. **

 

Correct Passage:__ *Rabindranath Tagore founded a small school at Santiniketan in 1901 and Kala Bhavan, an art school, in 1919 which later became a part of the Visvabharati University founded in 1921. Located in an idyllic village some distance from the city of Calcutta, Kala Bhavan presented an alternative methodology of art training, in which studio based practice was rejected in favour of learning through observation and living as a part of nature. The natural surroundings with the **vistas** of bare red earth dotted with trees, the colours of the changing seasons, the animals and birds (5)________ inspiration to students.*
